subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if yes should the accepted path be a default-off KaTeX/MathJax config surface with explicit dependency and sanitizer approval?
rationale: The feature is useful and aligned with web frontend ergonomics, but it changes core UI rendering, config, dependency, and untrusted-content sanitizer boundaries that automation should not accept by default.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one current KaTeX or MathJax PR to completion with dependency/security approval, default-off config acceptance, parser hardening, and exact-head Control UI proof.

options.title: Defer to extension design
options.body: Keep core markdown unchanged for now and ask for a plugin/API design only if current extension points cannot safely provide math rendering.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close the feature and associated candidate PRs with a product rationale that first-party Control UI math rendering is not planned now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one current KaTeX or MathJax PR to completion with dependency/security approval, default-off config acceptance, parser hardening, and exact-head Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal across original chat markdown behavior, adjacent config/dependency ownership, and the recently merged Android KaTeX direction.
